about: Fast subset of questions.json - one pure read, one click-actuation, one on a second dashboard. Runs in a couple of minutes; use before a demo or after touching the agent core. Entries are copied verbatim from questions.json; if you change one there, change it here.

questions.question: Which publisher has the highest total sales in the Top 5 Publishers chart?
questions.notes: Baseline sanity check - 1 step, large labelled bars.

questions.question: Click the 'Electronic Arts' bar in the Top 5 Publishers chart to filter to that publisher, then report which single game has the highest global sales in the Top 10 Games chart
questions.notes: The settle-gate regression canary. An answer of 'Wii Sports' means the frame was captured before the action filter propagated.

questions.question: According to the Movies and TV Shows Distribution, what percentage of the Netflix catalog are Movies?
questions.notes: Second dashboard, so a workbook-specific failure does not hide behind VGS passing.
